module.purpose: Provides the organization administration route for configuring single sign-on, enforcing authenticated organization access and edit permissions before rendering the SSO interface.
module.summary: This server-rendered settings page generates localized metadata, reconstructs the legacy request context from Next.js headers and cookies, and retrieves the current server session. Users without a valid organization identity are redirected to general organization settings. Resource-based permissions determine whether the organization member can edit SSO configuration, and the resulting permission state is passed to the organization SSO view inside the standard settings header.
module.businessContext: This supports organization-level identity and access management through SSO configuration. If it fails, organization administrators cannot manage authentication settings or may access the wrong settings area.
functions: generateMetadata (~L14-21): Builds localized metadata for organization SSO configuration settings.
Page (~L23-48): Authenticates organization administrators and renders permission-aware SSO settings.

io: Reads request headers and cookies to build a legacy request context.
Reads the server session for the current request.
Reads resource permissions for the organization and user.
